<!-- Fill in what you can. One problem per report, please: it gets fixed sooner that way. -->

### Versions

Help > About shows both: the TRSToolGui version and build, and the trs80-tool version (the "Engine" line).

- TRSToolGui:
- trs80-tool:

### System

Windows and its version, or the Linux distribution, its version and the desktop (GNOME, KDE, Cinnamon, Xfce and so on), or the macOS version and whether the Mac has Apple Silicon or an Intel processor.

### What you did

The steps, from starting the program, so the problem can be repeated.

### What happened, and what you expected

### Error text

The text of any error box, word for word. On Linux, start TRSToolGui from a terminal and paste what it prints there. On a Mac, do the same in Terminal with `/Applications/TRSToolGui.app/Contents/MacOS/TRSToolGui`.

### The disk image

If it happens with one disk image, attach it zipped, or say where it can be downloaded. A screenshot helps when something looks wrong.
